title: The Voice Below
text: A buried speaker edits every decision before it reaches the tongue.
flavor: One choice always arrives already forbidden.
origin: The Core answered a question the operative had not yet asked.
burdenText: Events with at least three choices deterministically seal one valid option.
adaptationText: Once per round, inspect one hidden consequence before committing.
trigger: An Event creates at least three valid choices.
penalty: One valid option is deterministically sealed.

effect.text: The Voice Below sealed one path.

relief: Purge this Scar at the Sable Machine Choir.
upside: Inspect one hidden consequence each round.
